tara_pm: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for the Optimize Toolkit (batching + prefix caching + quantization recommendations). Need concrete acceptance criteria, rollback conditions, and edge-case notes. Targets I'm proposing: ~30% token-cost reduction on batchy workloads, <=5% relative quality regression on our eval suites, and no more than 10ms added p95 latency on typical short requests. Thoughts?

miles_ml: Agree on cost goal but suggest splitting targets by workload class (chat vs embeddings vs classification). For quality: propose 'task-specific delta <= 3% relative' instead of flat 5%. We should also require per-model baselines and per-prompt baskets.

ben_platform: Rollout constraints: canary at 1% traffic with automated checks for regressions. If error rate > 2x baseline or quality delta > 3% we auto-rollback. Also need throttling config for batching to avoid tail latency spikes.

ben_platform: sample rollout/config snippet for the PRD: ```yaml
optimize_toolkit:
  batching:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_ms: 8
    max_batch_size: 64
  cache:
    prefix_kv: true
    ttl_ms: 60000
  quantization:
    profile: int8-hybrid
  rollout:
    canary_pct: 1
    monitor: [latency, quality, errors]
    rollback_on: {quality_delta_pct: 3, error_rate_mult: 2}
```

sara_m: Edge cases: streaming chat with long contexts — prefix caching could increase initial response jitter. Add explicit acceptance that streaming p95 must not increase >15ms for streams under 1024 tokens. Also: embeddings pipelines with small requests (<=16 tokens) shouldn't be negatively impacted by batching heuristics.

anya_sre: Security/compliance items to include: quantized model binaries must be signed and traced, KMS usage for keys when moving models between infra tiers, audit logs for cache hits/misses tied to request ids. Also ensure the private deployment path forbids cross-customer prefix caching.

miles_ml: Acceptance criteria draft (for PRD):
- Cost: measured end-to-end token compute cost reduction >=20% on production traces for target workload slices after 14 days of canary at 1% and 100% rollout.
- Quality: eval harness delta <=3% relative on per-workload baskets (chat QA F1, summarization ROUGE-L, instruction compliance). Must provide per-model failure examples.
- Latency: median latency change <=5ms and p95 increase <=10ms for short-turn routes (<256 tokens). For streaming routes, p95 increase <=15ms.
- Safety: no increase in server error rate >1% absolute or 2x relative (whichever smaller).
- Rollout: automatic rollback triggers for quality or error thresholds; manual gate for full 100% rollout requiring signoff from ML + Platform.

tara_pm: Nice. Add implementation acceptance checks too: canary dashboards (latency/quality/error) + synthetic prompt suite run every 10m. Also require a 'fallback' knob to disable quantization or caching per-model in runtime config.

ben_platform: Implementation notes: need runtime metrics + tagging: metric keys: optimize.batch_ms, optimize.cache_hit_{prefix,kv}, optimize.quant_profile. Add span hooks for eval comparisons.

ben_platform: For rollout instrumentation: suggest a small SQL schema example for the monitor pipeline:
```sql
CREATE TABLE optimize_monitors (
  ts TIMESTAMP,
  model TEXT,
  route TEXT,
  canary_pct INT,
  latency_p95_ms FLOAT,
  quality_delta_pct FLOAT,
  errors INT
);
```

miles_ml: Edge-case list to add to PRD:
- Very high-context prompts (>=16k) where KV caching might be expensive to materialize.
- Multi-turn stateful sessions where evicting prefix cache can change behavior mid-session.
- Quantization-induced tokenization artifacts for rarely-used tokens.
- Interaction with function-calling: ensure batched requests don't mix tool-call side effects.

tara_pm: Action items: @miles_ml to add eval baskets + automation; @ben_platform to add canary + metrics hooks and the config schema; @anya_sre to add security checklist and forbidden caching modes for private installs. I'll assemble PRD draft and ping for a review tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Document created: /docs/optimize-toolkit/prd-draft-1819007777 (owner: tara_pm) :sparkles:

sara_m: quick +1 on rollout gating. small nit: include a 'safety run' that replays last 24h of production requests against canary before warm rollout.

miles_ml: +1, add a 'quality delta per prompt id' breakdown so we can triage regressions quickly.

tara_pm: Great, I'll include those. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
